_comment: BAND-SPLIT. Band-local nodes for band1_lower_meadows. `order` is this entry's index in the merged array and is the ONLY thing that decides merge position -- never file order, never band order. Existing entries keep the index they had before the split because the merged array order is the order harvest nodes are added to the scene tree. A new entry in this band takes an unused order in this band's reserved range 1000-1999, which no other band can collide with; do not renumber an existing one.

nodes.label: Strip meadow grass
nodes._why_gate_a: Gate A natural paid-build evidence: an ordinary meadow-grass stop beside the open spine between the village and the pond route, far enough off the dirt to reward a short gathering detour without obstructing the critical trail. Together with the later pond-approach stop, this closes the fresh-session fiber shortfall without changing yields, costs, vendors, or global vegetation. Position is ground-probed and TUNABLE.

nodes.label: Strip meadow grass
nodes._why_gate_a: Gate A natural paid-build evidence: the second ordinary meadow-grass stop sits beside the authored spine as it turns toward the pond, so the player finds the final fiber in normal travel rather than by debug setup or an unreasonable search. It remains a short off-trail pull and does not densify the pond pocket itself. Position is ground-probed and TUNABLE.

nodes.label: Gather deadwood
nodes._why_d1: BAND1-D1. The pond-to-bridge corridor (z 552-1314) had zero authored gatherables before this pass -- the 2026-08-21 owner playtest names that exact stretch 'long, bare and boring'. Sited beside the pipwing cluster (spawns.json order 1002) so the first corridor stop reads as a place, not a lone marker in a field. tools/_probe_band1_cadence.py: ~30m lateral from the spine.

nodes.label: Prise loose stones
nodes._why_d1: BAND1-D1. Second corridor stop, roughly midway between the pond and South Bridge, paired with the trail_camp prop cluster (props.json order 1000) at the same bend -- a reason to slow down that lands with the rest stop rather than in open field. tools/_probe_band1_cadence.py: ~30m lateral from the spine.

nodes.label: Pick berries
nodes._why_d1: BAND1-D1. Third corridor stop, past the mudsnout cluster (spawns.json order 1004) and short of the south_bridge_grunt checkpoint -- the last thing to notice before the gate fight, not another silent kilometre leading into it. tools/_probe_band1_cadence.py: ~30m lateral from the spine.

nodes.label: Strip meadow grass
nodes._why_d1: BAND1-D1 remainder. tools/_probe_band1_cadence.py's own before/after run still showed a 388m gap right where the player leaves the pond -- the first corridor cluster (spawns.json order 1002) sits far enough south that the immediate post-pond stretch was still quiet. Closes it without touching the approved pond pocket itself (z=552-590, well north of this).

nodes.label: Prise loose stones
nodes._why_d1: BAND1-D1 remainder. The same probe's after-run left a 515m gap between the berries stop (order 1004) and the south_bridge_grunt checkpoint -- the run-in to the gate fight went quiet again. This sits past the spine's (330,1130)/(180,1200) bend, closing most of that gap while leaving the final stretch into the checkpoint itself alone; a gate fight should read as an arrival, not one more stop among several.

nodes.label: Gather deadfall
nodes._why_d1: Prompt 61's camp-siting criteria ask a camp-worthy space for 'nearby basic wood/stone/fiber availability', and the trail_camp had stone at 26m and nothing else authored -- wood and fibre came only from the shared scatter layers, which is availability by accident rather than by design. Deadfall 7m north-west of the fire: close enough to be the obvious answer to 'I want to build here', far enough that it is not inside the camp's own composition.

nodes.label: Cut long grass
nodes._why_d1: The fibre half of the same requirement, on the opposite side of the camp from the deadfall so gathering both is a short walk around the fire rather than one stop. stylized_nature's tall grass, matching the tufts already authored at this camp -- environment/nature's grass models render as flat cyan through this path (ralph/BLOCKED.md).

_why_gate_b_three_beds: OWNER DIRECTIVE 2026-08-23 §1: three creature beds must be affordable before tournament sign-up, and the gatherable budget is raised NEAR THE VILLAGE to pay for them rather than by sending the player further afield. Orders 1020-1027 are that raise: +12 wood and +20 fiber on the practice-path loop the first day already walks. The arithmetic it has to cover is house 39 wood / 34 stone, three creature beds 18 wood / 24 fiber (6 + 8 each, data/items/buildables.json), and the camp 12 wood / 8 stone / 10 fiber -- 69 / 42 / 34, which is tests/helpers/gate_a_material_route.gd's TARGET_STOCK. The old 57 / 42 / 18 bought exactly one bed against an entry gate that wants three rested entrants (tournament.gd::condition_ready, creature_bed.gd's single occupant).
